title: Dominic and the Alibi
author: Ines Iversen
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
